title: Fix 7 stale 'HARDCODED STRING' comments in upgrade_to_cloud_screen_l1_test.dart — the strings are l10n-sourced now
rule: AG-8-adjacent (comments must not misrepresent current source state) / AX-2

evidence.quote: // HARDCODED STRING: "Confirm your password" is not sourced from l10n.
// HARDCODED STRING: "You're signed in as …" body text is hardcoded.
// HARDCODED STRING: "Password required" is hardcoded in the validator.
// HARDCODED STRING: this message is hardcoded in _submit().
// HARDCODED STRING: "Incorrect password." is hardcoded in the catch block.
// HARDCODED STRING: internet error message is hardcoded.
// HARDCODED STRING: "You're backed up!" in _SuccessBlock is not l10n-sourced.

why: None of the 7 strings these comments call out as hardcoded actually appear as literals in upgrade_to_cloud_screen.dart — grepping the source finds zero hits, and every one is confirmed sourced from a matching AppLocalizations getter with an identical English ARB value (e.g. app_en.arb:1514 upgradeToCloudPasswordLabel = 'Confirm your password', :1526 upgradeToCloudSuccessTitle = "You're backed up!"). The code was fixed in an earlier wave but these test comments were never updated, so they now misrepresent the file's current AX-2 compliance to the next reader/agent — who might waste time 'fixing' a non-issue or, worse, assume any future l10n regression here is 'already known'.
recommendation: Delete or correct the 7 comments to note the strings are AppLocalizations-sourced (cite the ARB keys), so the file accurately documents current state.
acceptance_criteria: None of the 7 comments in upgrade_to_cloud_screen_l1_test.dart claim a string is hardcoded/not-l10n-sourced when grepping upgrade_to_cloud_screen.dart shows it is.

corrections: The 7th evidence entry's line should be 710, not 709 — the quoted comment text is verbatim correct, just one line off.
